# Summary
### Chapter Key Takeaways

- Rust provides zero-cost memory safety without a garbage collector through static ownership analysis.
- `rustup` is the toolchain manager; keep it updated with `rustup update`.
- `rustc` compiles code, but day-to-day workflow centers on `cargo check`, `cargo build`, `cargo test`, and `cargo run`.
- Every Rust binary begins at `fn main()` and projects are configured through `Cargo.toml`.
